facts.text: TactileEnv is a Gymnasium environment: the class inherits from gym.Env
The action space is Box(low=-0.015, high=0.015, shape=(n_actions,), dtype=float32)
The observation space is Box(low=-1000, high=1000, shape=(n_observations,), dtype=float32)
The environment downsamples the object to 2 * 136 * 2 = 544 particle indices, or uses every particle when the object has fewer
step increments time_step, applies the action, computes the observation and reward, calls check_termination and returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
reset accepts seed and options but never reads either: it re-initialises the contact model and returns (observation, info)

For task box_open, get_observations concatenates the downsampled object particle positions with the sensor translation (3 values) and Euler angles (3 values); with obs_tactile it also appends the tactile marker positions and the predicted force
compute_rewards uses scale = 1.0 for task box_open and returns scale * 2000 - delta_loss
check_termination returns True when time_step reaches time_limit

The box_open task is registered with n_actions = 6, state_n_observations = 2 * 136 * 2 * 3 + 6, tactile_n_observations = 2 * 136 + 4 * 136 * 3 + 3 + 6, dt = 5e-5 s, total_steps = 600, sub_steps = 50 and obj = earpod-case.stl
The baseline passes time_limit = task.total_steps to the environment

Contact.apply_action for box_open reads the six action elements as a position delta and an orientation delta, adds a 0.8 offset on one position axis depending on the phase, and runs sub_steps - 1 solver updates

determinism.notes: the fake seeds its placeholder particle field from reset(seed) and is deterministic for one seed; upstream reset accepts seed and options but never reads them (tactile_env.py:104-123), and no fake trajectory was compared with the upstream FEM/MPM simulator

gaps: the fake replaces the FEM tactile sensor and the MPM object solver with a placeholder particle field: no contact, deformation, material, friction, force or rendering model is integrated, and every observation value is test data

the fake returns the full state observation of the registered box_open task, 544 particle positions times 3 coordinates plus 6 sensor pose values = 1638 values; the tactile observation branch of the task has 1913 values (register_tasks.py:74-75) and is NOT COVERED
upstream reset accepts seed and options but never reads them; the fake uses the seed for its placeholder particles, so a seed changes the fake's initial observation and not upstream's

timestep_ms is the simulated time of one transition from the cited constants: box_open runs sub_steps - 1 = 49 solver updates at dt = 5e-5 s (box_open.py:526-527; register_tasks.py:76 and :78), 2.45 ms; the fake does not integrate physics and advances no simulated time
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and ticks advance the lockstep counter only
no snapshot or restore: TactileEnv exposes no get_state/set_state
the upstream package was not installed, imported or run, and the fake was never compared with it
no rendering: the upstream render method needs Taichi GUI handles and is not served

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulated contact loop is frozen: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
